Chapter 6547: My Disciples Are Immortals

Chapter 6547: My Disciples Are Immortals

“Got scared?” The skull laughed.

“The brat doesn’t know the meaning of that word, his flaw is his kind heart but it is also the reason for his success.” Li Qiye said, becoming slightly emotional with a tinge of pride.

“A kind immortal? That’s suicidal.” The skull said.

“It is why I worry about him but it is his original pursuit. As long as he is willing to die while maintaining conviction, he’ll have a good death.”

“You make it sound grim.” The skull said.

“I’m uncertain about his fate.” Li Qiye shook his head: “He listened to a few things but remained stubborn about others. Given the situation right now, he didn’t go.”

“If he is as good as you make him seem, then he’s having a great life, perhaps Heavenrealm is unified.” The skull said.

“That’s not his style, he has a different goal.” Li Qiye said.

“Which is? What else can make him risk death?” The skull became curious.

“Do you know Mang?” Li Qiye asked. [1]

“I don’t know Mang or whatever. As you know, the villainous heaven started having plans about sealing us. We got the right opportunity when it was distracted and escaped... Wait, that Mang?” The skull asked.

“Who knows all the details? It would take three days and three nights to elaborate.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Damn, it does sound right. It’s an issue then.” The skull contemplated and said.

“Why was it distracted back then?” Li Qiye asked.

“We don’t have a consensus on this, everyone has a different opinion. I thought something unstable occurred.”

“Unstable how?” Li Qiye asked.

“You know.” The skull said.

“Didn’t we say it was Mang?” Li Qiye said.

“Impossible, it’s just a plausible theory. If it were true, then you have it.” The skull said.

“It’s real.” Li Qiye smiled: “How else would I have this thing? It didn’t pop out of nowhere.”

“That makes sense.” The skull said: “But you’re not the only one who knows about it.”

“Yes, why was I successful though? Was it because I was unkillable with everlasting life? No.” Li Qiye said.

“You thought about this and figured out the secret, the right decision.” The skull said.

“For a long time, numerous near-death adventures or rather, so many deaths.” Li Qiye gazed at the horizon.

Although he spoke casually, those aware of the details could imagine the horrific paths and suffering entailed.

“So Mang was real.” The skull said.

“And in a form not inferior to you all.” Li Qiye said.

“Please, nothing can compare to us primordial immortals. We were the first and the best.” The skull sneered.

“Is that so?” Li Qiye smirked.

“A devilish monster like you doesn’t count, can’t use reason to describe you.” The skull said.

“You might say I’m exaggerating but the villainous heaven became unstable for a reason.” Li Qiye said.

“So let’s not walk around in circles and get back to your prized disciple, just brag about how amazing he is and get it over with.” The skull said.

“I’m worried because if he didn’t embark, he must be stirring trouble elsewhere.” Li Qiye said.

“Challenging the heaven is pointless when he’s not at your level but if he wants to be a Mang, that’s worth watching too.” The skull said.

“More than that.” Li Qiye sighed.

“Fine, fine, I admit that your disciple is amazing. Let’s forget this one. How many other immortal disciples do you have?” The skull said.

“There’s a girl with a terrible temper, always suppressing this and that.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“And?” The skull asked.

Li Qiye paused for a while before answering: “I sent her a message, telling her to sever herself.”

“What?!” The skull shouted: “You told an immortal to self-sever? Are you insane?! What were you thinking?”

“Nothing, I just wanted her to reach a greater height.” Li Qiye smiled wryly: “She’s a stubborn one who doesn’t change her mind.”

He paused and revealed a warm smile: “Despite our fractured relationship, she still listened, only leaving one intent behind after the severing.”

“Look at you, smiling and gloating out of pride, didn’t know you have such basic emotions in you.” The skull said.

“They are worthy of pride.” Li Qiye said.

“Why did you tell her to sever? Becoming an immortal isn’t easy.” The skull was curious.

“Not giving up is her nature, regardless of adversity and suffering.” Li Qiye said.

“I like that personality, I prefer to die instead of running away.” The skull praised.

“It’s good to be unyielding but there are times when one needs to take a breather and let everything settle, turn the indomitable spirit and dao heart into sharper weapons. This will let her surpass everything prior.” Li Qiye said.

“Your focus and legacy are the dao heart.” The skull said.

“Yes, I’ve always taught them to cultivate using the dao heart. Although they focus on different things, the dao heart still leads them.” Li Qiye said.

“Such a bad guy, spreading suffering to others.” The skull said.

“The bitterness of the dao is endless, at least the dao heart will keep them going.” Li Qiye sighed.

“Well, you have my admiration, cruel to yourself and your disciples.” The skull said.

“A towering tree can’t grow in a greenhouse.” Li Qiye said: “They have to bear the suffering or it will be you who suffers.”

“I agree, damn. Big Eye and the others protected their disciples from everything so they suffered in the end. Haha, did you laugh at them?” The skull asked.

“Everyone has a different teaching style so I didn’t laugh at them. I did think it was precious than all of you still have love despite living for so long.” Li Qiye said earnestly.

“Bah, love? They were only teaching a disciple.” The skull didn’t admit it.

1. Mang was mentioned in chapter 5908. ☜
